ideas.title: Investigating Fraud in Minnesota Child Care Programs
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of fraud in Minnesota child care programs and the impact of the federal funding freeze block.
questions: What is the extent of fraud in Minnesota child care programs?
How will the federal funding freeze block impact these programs?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and abuse in Minnesota child care programs. By following the money and examining public records, we can determine the extent of the problem and hold those responsible accountable.
